svg.font-family: 'Comic Sans MS', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Neue', 'Bradley Hand', casual, sans-serif
svg.title: Transmitter: one serializer path, level by level
svg.desc: One of the two binary paths of the transmitter. prbs_gray_src gives 32 lanes at 0.875 Gb/s. L0 dff_cmos_x32 retimes them on clk0p875. L1, 16 mux2_cmos selected by clk0p875, gives 16 lanes at 1.75 Gb/s. L2, 8 mux2_cmos selected by clk1p75, gives 8 lanes at 3.5 Gb/s. dff_tspc_x8 retimes on clk3p5. L3, 4 mux2_cs on clk3p5, an ideal placeholder, gives 4 lanes at 7 Gb/s and goes from CMOS to CML. cml_dff_x4 retimes on clk7. L4, 2 mux2_cml_hr selected by clk7, gives the even and odd streams at 14 Gb/s. ffe_tapgen_hr on clk14 makes pre, main and post taps as even and odd streams. FIN, 3 mux2_cml_hr on clk14, gives pre, main and post at 28 Gb/s. Both paths then go through 6 predriver_cml into pam4_driver, whose six tail currents come from tx_bias.

g.text: Transmitter: one serializer path, level by level
Each 2:1 level halves the lanes and doubles their rate, so the path stays at 28 Gb/s. The tap generator then makes three copies.
lanes after the cell: one box per lane, a strip is 28 Gb/s wide
this path's half of the 64-bit PRBS7 word
tx_ser_ffe_path one binary path. There are two: the MSB path and the LSB path.
placeholder: an ideal cell, nobody owns it yet
retimed. Lane 0 also goes to the phase_aligner.
even and odd symbols: half rate from here on
6 x predriver_cmlone per path and tap
adds the 6 taps: MSB path = 2 x LSB path
Weights: pre 0.05, main 0.80, post 0.15. Pre and post subtract.
Lane order: lane j carries time slot j, and slot 0 is sent first. A 2:1 level merges lane k (first) with lane k + N/2.
CMOS on one side, CML on the other
